dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags, conflicts, preserved empty-selection path, and help example are implemented and covered by the focused package test.
evidence: product.diff: item-list flags and command example

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Resolution uses case-insensitive names, canonical field objects, candidate-bearing errors, and sorted ambiguity IDs.
evidence: tests.log: focused query and item-list packages pass

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: The existing item query supplies initial fields; continuation is gated on selection and loops remaining field pages, returning errors before rendering.
evidence: product.diff: CompleteProjectFields and selected-field run tests

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All specified scalar, structured, and multi-value types are rendered, with empty unknown values and newline normalization.

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Selected headers and cells are appended in request order; lookup compares field node IDs and emits an empty cell when absent.

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Resolution and pagination failures return before output; the change reuses existing query types and remains focused on item listing and shared field queries.
evidence: product.diff: runList error ordering and CompleteProjectFields
